perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: Mobileye has an announced Evercore ADAS/AV/AI Forum appearance on 2026-09-29; this is a near-term information catalyst, not evidence of business performance by itself.

risks: Conference participation may produce no material new disclosure and should not be treated as an operating catalyst until source-backed information changes.
unknowns: Whether the September 29 forum will include new quantitative commercialization, robotaxi, Mentee or ADAS disclosures.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: The issuer scheduled the September 29 Evercore forum after its September 8 Goldman Sachs appearance; the event creates a dated checkpoint for previously announced 2027/2028 execution targets but does not itself close underwriting gaps.

risks: Previously announced 2027 production/robotaxi and 2028 humanoid commercialization targets remain forward-looking until operational evidence is published.
unknowns: No new primary quantitative operating result was located after the existing Q2 evidence in this bounded assist search.

facts: Mobileye announced participation in Evercore's 9th Annual ADAS, AV & AI Forum on September 29, 2026.
The same notice listed Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 8, 2026.

result: New dated primary-source monitoring checkpoint added; useful for catalyst/execution timing but insufficient alone for numeric underwriting.
